BORDER CLOSURES — GLOBAL ATLAS

Map, Analysis and Methods use the corrected 23 October 2026 workbook throughout.
Open Border_Closures_Atlas.html in a browser for the self-contained atlas.
The web directory is also ready for static hosting.

Map: locations, current phase dates, duration, source links and timeline.
Analysis: revised rationale categories, timing coverage, register and methods.
Methods: scope, evidence, review limits, mapping and timing guidance.
Save view: a framed PNG of the current map and accompanying source notes.
Download CSV: the full set of filtered closure records, including source links.

The map and Analysis share one compiled model. Initial audits and historical
parent claims are labelled separately from the current conclusions. Dated
observations and held evidence do not become confirmed intervals. Unknown
onsets and endpoints remain unknown; last confirmation is not reopening.
Only approved phase-location bindings support a dated geographical association.
Individual crossing dots remain hidden. The register retains short land-border
interruptions; airport and sea-only restrictions remain outside this release.

The data and map assets are bundled; no external tile server is required.
Evidence links need an internet connection. The toolkit README explains how to
rebuild every output from the workbook, which is preserved unchanged in source/.
